$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陽獨坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.123。

rules.text: 你的太陽在巳，較積極，也不易招惹是非。
rules.en: Your Sun sits in Si: more active, and less likely to stir up disputes.

source.quote: 巳宫的太阳不易招惹是非

rules.text: 你的太陽在亥，較消極，容易招惹是非。
rules.en: Your Sun sits in Hai: more passive, and more likely to stir up disputes.

rules.text: 積極的一面較重：不但利於進取，抵抗逆境的能力也強。
rules.en: The active side is stronger: good for pushing ahead, and strong at weathering adversity.

rules.text: 消極的一面較重：愈退縮，愈招是非怨尤；遇到好的時機，要藉機改變人生觀。
rules.en: The passive side is stronger: the more you withdraw, the more disputes and resentment you draw; when a good time comes, use it to change your outlook.

source.quote: 而消极者则往往愈冷退愈招是非尤怨

rules.text: 積極的你，行到紫微天府所在的運，是人生的大關口。
rules.en: Being the active kind, the phase that runs through Zi Wei–Tian Fu is the great turning point of your life.

source.quote: 积极的太阳最宜经行，为人生大结穴

rules.text: 天同所在的那一步運，是你創立事業的時候。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tian Tong is your time to found your own enterprise.

source.quote: 积极者却为创立事业的运限

rules.text: 天同所在的那一步運，你最容易失了志氣；那段時間要給自己定目標。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tian Tong is when you most easily lose heart; in that time, set yourself a goal.

source.quote: 消极的太阳最易因之丧志

rules.text: 巨門所在的那一步運，甚至只是那一年，對你都是重要的運程。
rules.en: The phase, or even just the year, that runs through Ju Men is an important one for you.

source.quote: 亦为太阳坐命者的重要运程
